mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_name, display_order, use_status FROM menu WHERE use_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, display_order, menu_name
SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_name, display_order, use_status FROM menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE menu SET display_order = #{displayOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
